BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
UPDATE dc SET [CompanyName] = sc.[CompanyName] ,[ContactName] = sc.[ContactName] ,[ContactTitle] = sc.[ContactTitle] ,[Address] = sc.[Address] ,[City] = sc.[City] ,[Region] = sc.[Region] ,[PostalCode] = sc.[PostalCode] ,[Country] = sc.[Country] ,[Phone] = sc.[Phone] ,[Fax] = sc.[Fax] FROM [dbo].[DimCustomer] dc INNER JOIN [staging].[customer] sc ON dc.[CustomerID] = sc.[CustomerID]; END

UPDATE de SET [LastName] = se.[LastName] ,[FirstName] = se.[FirstName] ,[FullName] = se.[FullName] ,[Title] = se.[Title] ,[TitleOfCourtesy] = se.[TitleOfCourtesy] ,[BirthDate] = se.[BirthDate] ,[HireDate] = se.[HireDate] ,[City] = se.[City] ,[Region] = se.[Region] ,[Country] = se.[Country] ,[ReportsTo] = se.[ReportsTo] ,[SupervisorName] = se.[SupervisorName] FROM [dbo].[DimEmployee] de INNER JOIN [staging].[employee] se ON de.[EmployeeID] = se.[EmployeeID]; END

BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
UPDATE f SET [OrderDateKey] = CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), so.[OrderDate], 112)) ,[RequiredDateKey] = CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), so.[RequiredDate], 112)) ,[ShippedDateKey] = ISNULL(CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), so.[ShippedDate], 112)), 19000101) ,[CustomerKey] = dc.[CustomerKey] ,[EmployeeKey] = de.[EmployeeKey] ,[ShipperKey] = dsh.[ShipperKey] ,[ShipLocationKey] = dl.[ShipLocationKey] ,[UnitPrice] = so.[UnitPrice] ,[Quantity] = so.[Quantity] ,[Discount] = so.[Discount] ,[AllocatedFreight] = so.[AllocatedFreight] ,[DaysToShip] = so.[DaysToShip] ,[DaysLate] = so.[DaysLate] FROM [dbo].[FactSales] f INNER JOIN [dbo].[DimProduct] dp ON f.[ProductKey] = dp.[ProductKey] INNER JOIN [staging].[orders] so ON f.[OrderID] = so.[OrderID] AND dp.[ProductID] = so.[ProductID] INNER JOIN [dbo].[DimCustomer] dc ON dc.[CustomerID] = so.[CustomerID] INNER JOIN [dbo].[DimEmployee] de ON de.[EmployeeID] = so.[EmployeeID] INNER JOIN [dbo].[DimShipper] dsh ON dsh.[ShipperID] = so.[ShipVia] INNER JOIN [dbo].[DimShipLocation] dl ON dl.[ShipCity] = so.[ShipCity] AND dl.[ShipRegion] = so.[ShipRegion] AND dl.[ShipCountry] = so.[ShipCountry] AND dl.[ShipPostalCode] = so.[ShipPostalCode]; END
